Evere — Brussels, Belgium

In detail

Evere is one of the 19 official communes of the Brussels-Capital Region. BISA (Brussels Institute for Statistics and Analysis), citing Federale Politie figures, recorded 2,828 total registered crimes and misdemeanours here in 2025, across a population of 45,892 residents (Statbel, 2025) — a rate of 6,162 offences per 100,000 residents, roughly 0.5x the citywide average, below it. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central, station, or nightlife-heavy commune can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential commune can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Brussels — real BISA / Federale Politie and Statbel figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Evere safe?

Wandroz currently rates Evere in Brussels, Belgium as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Brussels, Belgium, based on BISA (Brussels Institute for Statistics and Analysis), citing Federale Politie figures. This source has no time-of-day breakdown, so this is one overall level rather than a separately measured day and night figure — see the note on this page before treating the day/night badges as independently measured.

Does Evere's rating cover night-time safety specifically?

Not separately. BISA (Brussels Institute for Statistics and Analysis), citing Federale Politie figures publishes one figure per zone with no time-of-day split, so Evere's day and night badges show the same underlying level rather than an independently measured night figure. Treat it as a general indicator, not a night-specific measurement.

Is Evere a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Evere's rating is a useful general indicator, but this data is normalised against registered residents, not visitor footfall — busy tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher without that meaning elevated risk for a visitor passing through. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

What official data is Evere's rating based on?

BISA (Brussels Institute for Statistics and Analysis), citing Federale Politie figures, covering Evere's real administrative boundary. This is a genuine official dataset, not a qualitative judgment or press research — see the methodology page for the exact figures, the year they cover, and how the rate is calculated.
